correctness_confidence.basis: I re-derived by hand the Theorem 4 triangle vertices and weights, the block structure of Lemma 5 (cross terms vanish by phase covariance), the reverse-channel parameters (20), the environment spectrum (15), Cor. 11 Vieta identities and J'(1/2)>0 in Prop. 12. All consistent. Rests on unverified external Lemma 2 (Tang et al.) and Berta et al. (16).

rigor.basis: Statements are precise, antecedents and scope limits are explicit, external dependencies are listed (Lemma 2, E_F continuity, HJW, eq. 16). Weaker spots: Cor. 13 induction, the mixed-input step of Thm 1 and the deficit identity (23) are terse; numerics are explicitly not interval-certified.

novelty.basis: Genuine but incremental: a third vertex extends the 2026 pure-output and GAD block inequalities to the full Davies region, then standard MSW/Holevo/Berta machinery yields additivity, complement capacity and a Choi-cost separation. Overlap with concurrent GAD work [3,4] is disclosed; I could not check priority (no web use).

significance.basis: Arbitrary-partner Holevo additivity and exact capacities for a physically relevant two-parameter-plus-dephasing nonunital qubit family, plus a complementary-channel simulation cost strictly above Choi cost, are of solid but specialised interest. Qubit-only, memoryless, original channel's simulation cost left open.

reproducibility.basis: Appendix A lists scripts, versions and compared outputs, and a few exact values (J'(1/2)=ln(2^6 3^9/7^7)/10, D=-55/192) I confirmed by hand. I had no access to the supplement or code, so I executed nothing; floating-point checks are error-finding aids, not certificates.

summary: The manuscript extends a 2026 triangular block-entropy inequality to the full qubit Davies region via a third vertex (Lemma 3 plus concavity), derives a population-resolved output-entropy bound, and from it strong Holevo additivity with arbitrary partners for the Davies channel and its complement, scalar convex-envelope capacity formulas, strong EoF additivity on the Stinespring range, and a complementary parallel simulation cost (with a flat-roof closed form and a strict separation from Choi cost). My hand checks of the main algebraic steps found no error. Main limits: reliance on unverified external results, narrow scope, heavy overlap with concurrent GAD work, and uncertified numerics.
strengths: Third-vertex argument (Thm 4) is short and checks out: vertices, weights and the bound at A, B, C verify.
Lemma 5 hidden assumption (vanishing population-coherence cross terms) holds for Davies maps by phase covariance.
Reverse-channel closure (20) keeps the Davies region; I verified a_p, b_p and lambda_p by direct computation.
Prop. 12 separation is proved in exact arithmetic and depends only on lower bounds plus (16).
Candid scoping: overlaps, concurrent work, external dependencies and non-certified numerics are stated.
weaknesses: Lemma 2 (Tang et al.), E_F continuity and Berta et al. Theorem 12 are imported unverified; the whole additivity chain depends on Lemma 2.
Qubit Davies only, memoryless, with the original channel's simulation cost, adaptive cost and quantum capacity open.
Cor. 13 and eq. (23) are given with minimal proof; Thm 1 mixed-input step is a one-line appeal to concavity.
Numerical tables are floating-point only; supplement not inspectable from the PDF.
Provenance: AI-drafted and AI-reviewed with prior-involved reviewers; no human peer review.
potential_errors: Section 8 strict interior example uses lambda^2=1/2 while Prop. 12 uses lambda^2=1/10 for the same (a,b); easy to conflate, not an error.
Cor. 13 induction over conditional remaining states with nonidentical channels is only sketched; the step combining populations by convexity of each f_i needs explicit statement.

Berta et al. formula (16) is applied to a channel whose Stinespring range need not be full; the cited theorem's exact hypotheses (maximization over inputs, diamond-norm convergence) should be quoted verbatim.
strong_novelty_candidates: Strong convex-roof superadditivity (Thm 6) with arbitrary partner for all Davies maps and their complements, giving arbitrary-partner Holevo additivity.
Closure of the normalized reverse channel inside the Davies region, yielding an exact scalar formula for complementary parallel simulation cost and a strict separation from Choi-state cost.
